# Upgrade fixtures

Used by the harness in `src-tauri/src/upgrade_tests/` (see `docs/VALIDATION.md`).
Nothing here is read at run time by the app.

## `db/*.sql`

Each file rebuilds the `usage.db` a released version leaves behind: the DDL is
copied from that tag's source, the rows are a small synthetic dataset (4-5 usage
events, 5 quota samples, 2 ingest files; later versions add session, evaluation
and checkpoint rows). Nothing comes from a real user database.

| File | Covers tags | `schema_version` | Source of the DDL (`git show <tag>:...`) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `v0.2.2.sql` | v0.1.0 - v0.2.2 | 1 | `src-tauri/src/store/mod.rs` `migrate()` |
| `v0.3.0.sql` | v0.3.0, v0.4.0 - v0.4.2 | 2 | same, plus `ALTER TABLE usage_events ADD COLUMN reasoning_effort` |
| `v0.5.0.sql` | v0.5.0 | 2 | `store/mod.rs`, `sessions/store.rs` `ensure_schema`, `evaluation.rs` `ensure_schema` |
| `v0.6.0.sql` | v0.6.0 | 3 | `store/mod.rs` v3 step (`quota_samples.account`, `idx_quota_account_ts`) |

v0.3.0 and v0.4.x have an identical `store/` (checked with `git diff v0.3.0 v0.4.2`).

## `settings/*.json`

Hand-written from `git show <tag>:src-tauri/src/model.rs` (`struct Settings`
and `impl Default for Settings`), not generated by running the old binaries.

| File | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `v0.2.2-default.json` | what v0.1.x - v0.3.0 write on a fresh install (their `Settings` is identical) |
| `v0.4.0-default.json` | v0.4.x / v0.5.0: adds `percentPosition`, `autoPricingCheck` |
| `v0.6.0-default.json` | v0.6.0: adds label/ring style, accounts, notifications, webhook, `onboarded` (false on a fresh install), ... |
| `*-customised.json` | the matching default with every field changed to a valid non-default value (a heavy user); synthetic |

The test `the_default_fixtures_still_match_todays_defaults` fails when a
default changes after a release; that is a deliberate-behaviour-change alarm,
not necessarily a bug. Copilot is `enabled: false` in the fixtures because it
is only on when its credentials exist on the machine.
